references.text: The introduction of Rahab and the spies who came to her house, which the king of Jericho refers to in his message
Rahab is later rewarded for hiding the spies whom the king was seeking
Rahab's faith and action when she hid the spies from the king's men resulted in her and her family being spared
Moses sent spies to explore the land of Canaan, a mission similar to that of the spies in Jericho
The book of Hebrews mentions Rahab's faith when she received the spies and was not killed with the unbelievers
James uses Rahab as an example of faith shown through deeds when she received the messengers and sent them out by another way
